title: Reading list
audience: For readers whose to-read pile lives in screenshots and browser tabs.
description: A reading list with ratings and notes. Tell your AI about a book and it files it; ask it what to read next.
tagline: Books to read, reading and finished, rated.
seoTitle: Reading list template with notes for ChatGPT and Claude
note:
Reading list

Every book you want to read, are reading or have finished, with a line on why it's here.

<!-- pane-table: Title=text; Author=text; Status=choice To read|Reading|Finished|Dropped; Rating=scale 1-5; Why=text -->

## Notes

prompt.default: Use my Amber Notes note "Reading list". When I mention a book, add a row with log_table_row: Title, Author, Status To read, and in Why, who recommended it or why I want it. When I start or finish a book, update its Status (and Rating from 1 to 5 when I finish) with edit_note, after reading the note with read_note. Put my thoughts on a book under "Notes" with append_to_note, under a "###" heading with the title. When I ask what to read next, read the table with read_table and suggest from what's marked To read, based on what I rated highly.

asks: Add Piranesi, Maja says it's the best thing she read this year.
Finished Four Thousand Weeks. Four stars.

args.text:
### Four Thousand Weeks
You'll never get through everything, so choose what to neglect on purpose. Made me drop two side projects.
